{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPFnddiQcpg2KASaJVzb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Get\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn get <id>`, printing one transaction row or exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes | cli.main, format_amount |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRead a single transaction by id and print it in the transaction CSV shape. The command never writes.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` takes exactly one argument. The id is a base-10 integer.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Row found | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the row |\n| No row with that id | 4 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count, or an id that is not an integer | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count and parse the id; failure is a usage error.\n2. Read the row through `transactions.get`.\n3. If the result is `None`, fail with the not-found exit code.\n4. Print the header and one row. The amount is formatted from integer cents with `format_amount`: exactly two decimals, a leading `-` when negative, no thousands separator. An empty memo prints as an empty trailing field.\n\n## Reads\n\nThe `transactions` row for the id. Nothing else.\n\n## Writes\n\nNone.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txnget-present ===\nIntent: txn get prints the header and the stored row with a two-decimal amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TGACCT1\"\n    cat = \"TGCAT1\"\n    day = \"2026-04-01\"\n    memo = \"walk in sale\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=4550, memo=memo)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(new_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(new_id), day, acct, cat, \"45.50\", memo]\n=== END AC txnget-present ===\n\n=== AC txnget-negative-empty-memo ===\nIntent: A negative amount prints with a leading minus and an empty memo prints as an empty field.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TGACCT2\"\n    cat = \"TGCAT2\"\n    day = \"2026-04-02\"\n    memo = \"\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category Two\")\n    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=-1250, memo=memo)\n ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Amend\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`, changing only a transaction's amount while keeping every balance non-negative. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, format_amount, balance_guard, ledger txn get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCorrect the amount of an existing transaction. Date, account, category, and memo never change. The change is rejected before any write if it would leave the owning account's balance below zero.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` takes exactly two arguments.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Amended | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the updated row |\n| Amount fails `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has more than two decimals, or is zero | 3 | Nothing |\n| Resulting balance of the owning account would be below zero | 3 | Nothing |\n| No transaction with that id | 4 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count, or an id that is not an integer | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count and parse the id (usage error otherwise).\n2. Parse the amount with `parse_amount` into integer cents (rejection otherwise).\n3. Locate the transaction by listing transactions; if absent, fail with not found.\n4. List the owning account's transactions and ask `balance_guard` for the balance that results from replacing this row's amount; if any resulting balance is below zero, reject.\n5. Only after every check passes, write the new amount through `transactions.update`, then print the returned row.\n\n## Reads\n\nAll transactions, to locate the row, and the owning account's transactions, to compute the projected balance.\n\n## Writes\n\nThe `amount` column of exactly one `transactions` row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-004` — write: change a transaction amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list transactions to locate the row and compute the projected balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txnamend-success ===\nIntent: txn amend prints the updated row, changes only the amount, and persists it.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TAACCT1\"\n    cat = \"TACAT1\"\n    day = \"2026-04-01\"\n    memo = \"walk in sale\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=4550, memo=memo)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(new_id), \"54.50\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(new_id), day, acct, cat, \"54.50\", memo]\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=new_id)\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == 5450\n    assert stored.date == day\n    assert stored.account == acct\n    assert stored.category == cat\n    assert stored.memo == memo\n=== END AC txnamend-success ===\n\n=== AC txnamend-absent ===\nIntent: txn amend of an absent id exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1000\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(absent_id), \"5.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnamend-absent ===\n\n=== AC txnamend-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amendment that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and changes nothing.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TAACCT2\"\n    cat = \"TACAT2\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Overdraw\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Overdraw Category\")\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    credit_id = base + 1\n    debit_id = base + 2\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=credit_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"credit\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=debit_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-5000, memo=\"debit\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(debit_id), \"-200.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=debit_id)\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == -5000\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=credit_id).amount == 10000\n=== END AC txnamend-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txnamend-boundary-zero-balance ===\nIntent: An amendment that leaves the balance exactly zero is accepted.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TAACCT3\"\n    cat = \"TACAT3\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Boundary\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Boundary Category\")\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    credit_id = base + 1\n    debit_id = base + 2\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=credit_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"credit\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=debit_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-5000, memo=\"debit\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(debit_id), \"-100.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=debit_id)\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == -10000\n=== END AC txnamend-boundary-zero-balance ===\n\n=== AC txnamend-invalid-amount ===\nIntent: Malformed, over-precise, and zero amounts exit 3 and leave the row unchanged.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TAACCT4\"\n    cat = \"TACAT4\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Invalid\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Invalid Category\")\n    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=2000, memo=\"keep\")\n    for bad in (\"1.234\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"abc\", \"12.\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(new_id), bad)\n        print(bad, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=new_id).amount == 2000\n=== END AC txnamend-invalid-amount ===\n\n=== AC txnamend-usage ===\nIntent: Wrong argument counts and a non-integer id are usage errors with exit 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nfor args in ((\"txn\", \"amend\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"2.00\", \"3.00\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"abc\", \"2.00\")):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    print(args, code, out, err)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txnamend-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only the amount changes; date, account, category, and memo are never written.\n- The balance check runs before the first write; a rejected amendment leaves every table unchanged.\n- Amounts are integer cents at every layer; no floating point.\n- Standard output carries only the documented CSV; failures write one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n- Only the generated persistence package reaches the database.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn delete <id>`, removing one transaction while keeping every balance non-negative. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | cli.main, balance_guard, ledger txn get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove an existing transaction. The delete is rejected before any write if removing the row would leave the owning account's balance below zero.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>` takes exactly one argument.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Deleted | 0 | Two lines: `deleted`, then the id |\n| Removal would leave the owning account balance below zero | 3 | Nothing |\n| No transaction with that id | 4 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count, or an id that is not an integer | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count and parse the id (usage error otherwise).\n2. Locate the transaction by listing transactions; if absent, fail with not found.\n3. List the owning account's transactions and ask `balance_guard` for the balance that results from removing this row; if it is below zero, reject.\n4. Only after the checks pass, remove the row through `transactions.delete` and print `deleted` and the id.\n\n## Reads\n\nAll transactions, to locate the row, and the owning account's transactions, to compute the projected balance.\n\n## Writes\n\nRemoval of exactly one `transactions` row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — write: delete a transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Category\")\n    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=5450, memo=\"gone\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(new_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"deleted\"], [str(new_id)]]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=new_id) is None\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before - 1\n=== END AC txndelete-success ===\n\n=== AC txndelete-absent ===\nIntent: txn delete of an absent id exits 4 and removes nothing.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1000\n    before = len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txndelete-absent ===\n\n=== AC txndelete-negative-balance ===\nIntent: Deleting a credit that funds a later debit exits 3 and keeps both rows.\n\nfrom debit_id = base + 2\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=credit_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"credit\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=debit_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-5000, memo=\"debit\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(credit_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=credit_id) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=debit_id) is not None\n base + 2\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=credit_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"credit\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=debit_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnValidate.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Validate\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Specifies the input validation `ledger txn post` applies to category, amount, and date before it writes anything. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | txn post validation |\n| Consumes | ledger txn post, parse_amount, validate_date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nGuarantee that an invalid category, amount, or date given to `ledger txn post` is rejected with exit 3 before the first write, and that valid boundary inputs are accepted. Wiring lives in the post command; this specification owns the rules and their proof.\n\n## Rules\n\n| Input | Valid | Rejected with exit 3 |\n|-------|-------|----------------------|\n| Category | A code present in `categories` | An unknown category |\n| Amount | `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, never zero, so `12`, `12.5`, `-12.50` | More than two decimals (`1.234`), `12.`, a leading `+`, non-numeric text, empty text, `0`, `0.00`, `-0.00` |\n| Date | A real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`, including a leap day in a leap year | `2026-02-30`, `2026-02-29`, `2026-2-3`, non-date text |\n\nA rejected post writes no row, prints nothing to standard output, writes one diagnostic line to standard error, and consumes no transaction id: the next successful post receives one more than the largest id present.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-001` — read: look up the category named on input - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-unknown-category ===\nIntent: An unknown category exits 3 and writes no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT1\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Account\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, \"NOSUCHCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-unknown-category ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-bad-amounts ===\nIntent: Over-precise, malformed, and zero amounts exit 3 and write no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT2\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT2\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Amount\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Amount Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for bad in (\"1.234\", \"abc\", \"12.\", \"+5.00\", \"--1\", \"\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0.00\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, bad, \"2026-04-01\")\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-bad-amounts ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-bad-dates ===\nIntent: Impossible and malformed dates exit 3 and write no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT3\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT3\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Date\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Date Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for bad in (\"2026-02-30\", \"2026-02-29\", \"2026-13-01\", \"2026-2-3\", \"notadate\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", bad)\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-bad-dates ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-valid-boundaries ===\nIntent: A one-decimal amount and a leap-day date are accepted and stored as integer cents.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT4\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT4\"\n    leap_day = \"2028-02-29\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Valid\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Valid Category\")\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"12.5\", leap_day)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 1)\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == 1250\n    assert stored.date == leap_day\n=== END AC txnvalidate-boundaries-placeholder ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-no-id-gap ===\nIntent: A rejected post consumes no id, so the next successful post receives the next id.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT5\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT5\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Gap\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Gap Category\")\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], Both rows are stored or neither is.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` takes exactly four arguments.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Transferred | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Amount malformed, zero, or negative; date invalid; `from` equals `to`; either account unknown | 3 | Nothing |\n| Amount exceeds the balance of `from` | 3 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Rows Written\n\n| Row | Id | Account | Amount | Memo |\n|-----|----|---------|--------|------|\n| Outgoing | one more than the largest `txn_id` present, or 1 in an empty table | `<from>` | `-amount` | `transfer to <to>` |\n| Incoming | the outgoing id plus one | `<to>` | `+amount` | `transfer from <from>` |\n\nBoth rows use category `TRANSFER` and the given date.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. row or exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes | cli.main, format_amount |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRead a single transaction by id and print it in the transaction CSV shape. The command never writes.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` takes exactly one argument. The id is a base-10 integer.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Row found | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the row |\n| No row with that id | 4 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count, or an id that is not an integer | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count and parse the id; failure is a usage error.\n2. Read the row through `transactions.get`.\n3. If the result is `None`, fail with the not-found exit code.\n4. Print the header and one row. The amount is formatted from integer cents with `format_amount`: exactly two decimals, a leading `-` when negative, no thousands separator. An empty memo prints as an empty trailing field.\n\n## Reads\n\nThe `transactions` row for the id. Nothing else.\n\n## Writes\n\nNone.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=4550, memo=memo)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(new_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Amend\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`, changing only a transaction's amount while keeping every balance non-negative. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, format_amount, balance_guard, ledger txn get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCorrect the amount of an existing transaction. Date, account, category, and memo never change. The change is rejected before any write if it would leave the owning account's balance below zero.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` takes exactly two arguments.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Amended | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the updated row |\n| Amount fails `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has more than two decimals, or is zero | 3 | Nothing |\n| Resulting balance of the owning account would be below zero | 3 | Nothing |\n| No transaction with that id | 4 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count, or an id that is not an integer | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count and parse the id (usage error otherwise).\n2. Parse the amount with `parse_amount` into integer cents (rejection otherwise).\n3. Locate the transaction by listing transactions; if absent, fail with not found.\n4. List the owning account's transactions and ask `balance_guard` for the balance that results from replacing this row's amount; if any resulting balance is below zero, reject.\n5. Only after every check passes, write the new amount through `transactions.update`, then print the returned row.\n\n## Reads\n\nAll transactions, to locate the row, and the owning account's transactions, to compute the projected balance.\n\n## Writes\n\nThe `amount` column of exactly one `transactions` row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-004` — write: change a transaction amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list transactions to locate the row and compute the projected balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txnamend-success ===\nIntent: txn amend prints the updated debit_id = base + 2\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=credit_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"credit\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=debit_id, ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnValidate.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Validate\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Specifies the input validation `ledger txn post` applies to category, amount, and date before it writes anything. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | txn post validation |\n| Consumes | ledger txn post, parse_amount, validate_date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nGuarantee that an invalid category, amount, or date given to `ledger txn post` is rejected with exit 3 before the first write, and that valid boundary inputs are accepted. Wiring lives in the post command; this specification owns the rules and their proof.\n\n## Rules\n\n| Input | Valid | Rejected with exit 3 |\n|-------|-------|----------------------|\n| Category | A code present in `categories` | An unknown category |\n| Amount | `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, never zero, so `12`, `12.5`, `-12.50` | More than two decimals (`1.234`), `12.`, a leading `+`, non-numeric text, empty text, `0`, `0.00`, `-0.00` |\n| Date | A real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`, including a leap day in a leap year | `2026-02-30`, `2026-02-29`, `2026-2-3`, non-date text |\n\nA rejected post writes no row, prints nothing to standard output, writes one diagnostic line to standard error, and consumes no transaction id: the next successful post receives one more than the largest id present.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-001` — read: look up the category named on input - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-unknown-category ===\nIntent: An unknown category exits 3 and writes no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT1\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Account\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, \"NOSUCHCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-unknown-category ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-bad-amounts ===\nIntent: Over-precise, malformed, and zero amounts exit 3 and write no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT2\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT2\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Amount\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Amount Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for bad in (\"1.234\", \"abc\", \"12.\", \"+5.00\", \"--1\", \"\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0.00\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, bad, \"2026-04-01\")\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-bad-amounts ===\n\n=== AC txnvalidate-bad-dates ===\nIntent: Impossible and malformed dates exit 3 and write no row.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"TVACCT3\"\n    cat = \"TVCAT3\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Validate Date\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Validate Date Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for bad in (\"2026-02-30\", \"2026-02-29\", \"2026-13-01\", \"2026-2-3\", \"notadate\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", bad)\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txnvalidate-bad-dates ===\n\n=== txnvalidate-no-id-gap ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every check completes before the first write; a rejected post changes no table.\n- Amounts are parsed to integer cents; no floating point at any layer.\n- Rejections use exit 3, never exit 1 or 2.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`, writing two TRANSFER rows atomically. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, format_amount, validate_date, balance_guard |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nMove cash between two accounts as a pair of transactions in category `TRANSFER`. Both rows are stored or neither is.\n\n## Trigger and Interface\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` takes exactly four arguments.\n\n| Condition | Exit | Stdout |\n|-----------|------|--------|\n| Transferred | 0 | Header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Amount malformed, zero, or negative; date invalid; `from` equals `to`; either account unknown | 3 | Nothing |\n| Amount exceeds the balance of `from` | 3 | Nothing |\n| Wrong argument count | 2 | Nothing |\n| Database unreachable or tables missing | 1 | Nothing |\n\nOne diagnostic line goes to standard error on every failure.\n\n## Rows Written\n\n| Row | Id | Account | Amount | Memo |\n|-----|----|---------|--------|------|\n| Outgoing | one more than the largest `txn_id` present, or 1 in an empty table | `<from>` | `-amount` | `transfer to <to>` |\n| Incoming | the outgoing id plus one | `<to>` | `+amount` | `transfer from <from>` |\n\nBoth rows use category `TRANSFER` and the given date.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Check the argument count (usage error otherwise).\n2. Parse the amount into integer cents; it must be positive. Validate the date. Require `from` and `to` to differ.\n3. Confirm both accounts exist by listing accounts.\n4. List transactions; compute the next id and the balance of `from`. Ask `balance_guard` whether subtracting the amount leaves `from` at or above zero.\n5. Only after every check passes, write both rows in one database session, outgoing first. The writes use the transaction insert declared by FEATURE-TxnPost.md. A failure of either write leaves neither row stored.\n6. Print the header and the two rows.\n\n## Reads\n\nBoth accounts, and all transactions for the next id and the source balance.\n\n## Writes\n\nTwo `transactions` rows, or none.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm both accounts exist - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list transactions for the next id and the source balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-success ===\nIntent: A valid transfer prints two TRANSFER rows with consecutive ids and stores both.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"XFSRC1\"\n    dst = \"XFDST1\"\n    day = \"2026-04-03\"\n    opening = \"OPENX1\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=opening, description=\"Opening\")\n    db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\") if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None else None\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=opening, amount=10000, memo=\"fund\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"25.00\", day)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert out_row[:5] == [str(base + 2), day, src, \"TRANSFER\", \"-25.00\"]\n    assert in_row[:5] == [str(base + 3), day, dst, \"TRANSFER\", \"25.00\"]\n    assert out_row[5].split(\" \") == [\"transfer\", \"to\", dst]\n    assert in_row[5].split(\" \") == [\"transfer\", \"from\", src]\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 2)\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 3)\n    assert stored_out is not None and stored_in is not None\n    assert stored_out.amount == -2500 and stored_out.account == src\n    assert stored_in.amount == 2500 and stored_in.account ==
